answer: Plant identity on a trellis: every agent stakes locked funds, and its voting weight grows only through epochs of attested work. A hollow clone starts at zero weight and must lock the same capital for the same time before any vote counts, so an attacker needs a copy of the whole economy's stake to matter. Each epoch adds a pigment check - sign a per-agent, nonce-seeded challenge yielding a unique artifact - so clone farms cannot answer in unison. Duplicate accounts get slashed by peer attestation, making mass registration a losing trade.
